GO Wild Area update! 🌍

Gigantamax Duraludon makes its Pokémon GO debut!

GMax Duraludon will debut first during GO Wild Area in Sendai and Mexico City, then join the Global event.

Alongside its debut:
⚔️ Crowned Forms return in Sendai / Mexico City
❄️ Kyurem Fusions return during the Global event
